name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: Choosing one option from a small, fixed set.

motionProfile.reason: One local group entrance, one dot revision per changed option and one scoped palette per item; the option row and external labels keep their own owners.

data.transition/one-shot.reason: Radio Group owns one opacity entrance on a later-inserted group root; a presenting parent, a hidden host or an unusable group keeps native paint.

state.morph/one-shot.reason: Each option owns the dot revision on its own indicator: opacity and the authored scale pose, with only the actual old and new dots changing.

state.color/css-transition.reason: Each option owns its border, background, ring and dot palette; DOM focus, invalid state and an unverified caller palette settle that paint immediately.
